scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,site,admin -c cyan,green,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix admin run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix admin run build
scripts.preview: concurrently -k -n api,site,admin -c cyan,green,magenta "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run preview" "npm --prefix admin run preview"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix admin run typecheck
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix admin install
